description.value: Starbucks on United Boulevard is a drive-through coffee shop in Coquitlam offering the full range of Starbucks espresso drinks, teas, and packaged food items. The location includes outdoor seating and sits in a commercial corridor that touring cyclists passing through the Tri-Cities area may encounter. As a major chain with consistent offerings, it provides a predictable refreshment stop.
